evidence_gaps: Fresh-within-two-hours sanitized runtime forensics are unavailable; evidence.json reports MISSING_RUNTIME_FORENSICS with generated_epoch 0.
Decision-time quotes, quote ages, requested versus realized outputs, price impact and slippage by chain and route.
Transaction-level gas, priority, builder/platform fees, non-refundable rent, refundable rent and failed-attempt costs.
End-to-end execution funnel: opportunities, eligible signals, simulations, submissions, landings, reverts, expirations, reconciliation-pending events and duplicate-prevention outcomes.
Explicit loss classification separating STRATEGY/MARKET loss from EXECUTION/INFRASTRUCTURE failure, while charging both categories all incurred costs.
Realized money-weighted net P&L, exposure, drawdown, tail loss and profit factor by strategy, chain, venue, asset, size and market/fee regime.
Out-of-sample and parameter-freeze evidence showing results are not concentrated in one window, leader, asset or notional bucket.
Calibration error for Solana priority/failure reserves and EVM gas/inclusion reserves.

Before any promotion: cost-complete reconciled runtime samples meeting each proposal's minimum observation, positive out-of-sample money-weighted net, profit factor above 1, acceptable drawdown and failure rates, no unresolved reconciliation events, and confirmed sellability/liquidity/simulation protection.

proposals.downside_risk: Schema and event-classification complexity; incorrect attribution could conceal a genuine strategy defect.

evidence.detail: Windows record gross profit, gross loss, fees, slippage and an execution-failure count, but no failure class or failed-attempt cost.
Default net calculation is gross_profit minus gross_loss, fees and slippage; price impact, failed gas/priority fees and other execution costs are not explicit components.
Execution failures increment a counter but do not debit a supplied failed-execution cost from canary net P&L.

proposals.expected_effect: More reliable replacement decisions and direct visibility into whether losses require strategy changes or infrastructure repair.
proposals.minimum_observation: At least 100 eligible decisions, 30 costed executions and 10 naturally occurring or fault-injected failures per chain across at least 14 independent daily windows.
proposals.rationale: A strategy can have sound signals yet lose through RPC, signing, landing or reconciliation failures. Conversely, a correctly executed trade can lose because the market moved. These outcomes require separate attribution while every irreversible cost still reduces money-weighted net P&L.
proposals.shadow_test: For at least 100 eligible decisions per chain, replay SHADOW outcomes with immutable categories STRATEGY_MARKET_LOSS, EXECUTION_FAILURE and INFRASTRUCTURE_FAILURE. Debit simulated or observed gas, priority, builder, impact and failure costs. Stop if any event is unclassified, costs cannot reconcile to transaction-level evidence, or aggregate net differs from the event ledger beyond rounding tolerance.

proposals.downside_risk: Conservative reserves may reject real opportunities; incomplete rent treatment could double-count refundable amounts.

evidence.detail: SHADOW P&L uses fixed estimated entry and exit fees of 0.00002 SOL.
Entry validation uses current Jupiter round-trip quotes and deterioration checks, which is directionally sound.
Exit valuation subtracts the configured static exit fee rather than a quote-specific priority, platform, account-rent and failure reserve.

proposals.expected_effect: More conservative and chain-accurate SHADOW net P&L, with abstention during congested or unreliable execution regimes.
proposals.minimum_observation: At least 200 entry/exit quote pairs over 14 days, including congestion and low-liquidity periods, with at least 30 fully reconciled comparable transactions from sanitized runtime evidence.
proposals.rationale: Solana priority fees, route costs, refundable account rent and landing failure rates are regime-dependent. Static fee estimates can overstate executable edge even when quoted sellability is acceptable.
proposals.shadow_test: Record decision-time Jupiter output, price impact, priority-fee estimate, platform fees, token-account rent classification and expected failure cost. Compare static versus dynamic-cost net P&L without trading. Fail the hypothesis if dynamic estimates understate confirmed non-refundable costs by more than 10%, reconciliation coverage is below 99%, or money-weighted net is non-positive.

proposals.downside_risk: Gas reserve may still miss base-fee spikes, inclusion latency, reverted-transaction costs or adverse builder behavior.

evidence.detail: Wallet-specific simulation rejects routes whose quote does not cover a 30% gas-unit reserve plus configured minimum net profit.
The exact built transaction receives a mandatory immediate pre-broadcast eth_call; failures prevent signing.
Scanner output explicitly does not claim gas-adjusted profitability and defers to wallet-specific simulation.
Scanner rows remain marked simulation_ok=false and sellability_ok=false before the downstream execution gate.

proposals.expected_effect: Preserves fail-closed EVM protection and avoids sequential exposure or forced trades.
proposals.minimum_observation: At least 100 wallet-specific simulations and 30 independently reconciled executions per EVM chain across 14 days and multiple gas regimes.
proposals.rationale: The architecture appropriately avoids treating discovery-stage gross edge as executable profit and uses atomic output protection. This should remain unchanged pending fresh realized execution evidence.
proposals.shadow_test: For each candidate, archive quote, predicted gas, exact-call result and simulated inclusion outcome; calculate net after actual or contemporaneous gas, slippage and failures. Stop if any route passes with non-positive executable net, if p95 actual gas exceeds reserve, or if failure-cost-adjusted aggregate net is non-positive.

proposals.downside_risk: Longer evaluation periods and fewer promotion candidates.

evidence.detail: Metrics aggregate all selected windows without an explicit out-of-sample, regime or capital-exposure partition.
Replacement uses recorded net and profit factor, but promotion candidacy does not explicitly require drawdown, exposure-weighted return, cost completeness or failure-rate bounds.
Signal edge correctly subtracts fees, slippage, price impact and latency reserve, but runtime calibration of those inputs is unavailable.

proposals.expected_effect: Reduces overfitting and prevents high win count or favorable small-size samples from driving promotion.
proposals.minimum_observation: At least 30 independent out-of-sample windows, 100 eligible opportunities and 50 cost-complete SHADOW fills per chain, spanning at least three market or fee regimes.
proposals.rationale: Positive aggregate net can be concentrated in one regime or small notionals. Durable promotion requires unseen-window performance, complete costs and money-weighted results across realistic capital sizes.
proposals.shadow_test: Freeze parameters before evaluation and score sequential unseen windows by chain, venue, size and volatility regime. Include all execution and failure costs. Reject promotion if out-of-sample money-weighted net is non-positive, profit factor is at most 1, drawdown breaches the declared budget, or performance depends on a single window or size bucket.

rejected_ideas.idea: Promote any strategy because architecture contains positive-edge gates.
rejected_ideas.reason: Architecture demonstrates safeguards, not realized profitability; current runtime evidence is absent.

rejected_ideas.idea: Increase trade frequency or relax liquidity, sellability, simulation or minimum-edge thresholds.
rejected_ideas.reason: No evidence shows missed trades have positive executable net value, and forcing participation conflicts with the objective.

rejected_ideas.idea: Rank or retain strategies primarily by win rate.
rejected_ideas.reason: Win count ignores payoff magnitude and costs; money-weighted net P&L and drawdown must dominate.
Non-atomic legs introduce inventory, latency and partial-execution risk; the repository correctly keeps such candidates SHADOW-only without an atomic executor.

summary: Architecture-only review completed. EVM atomic-cycle execution has strong fail-closed quote, gas-reserve and immediate pre-broadcast simulation controls. Cross-chain SHADOW rules require positive cost-adjusted edge, liquidity and sellability. However, Strategy Lab accounting does not explicitly classify STRATEGY/MARKET losses versus EXECUTION/INFRASTRUCTURE failures or require failed-transaction costs in net P&L. Solana copy SHADOW accounting also relies on static fee estimates, which may misstate chain-specific net performance. With runtime forensics missing, no profitability, CANARY-readiness or LIVE-readiness conclusion is supported.
